OA_UrbanConstruction.questDescriptionRul.li:
questDescription->The settlement of the Rat tribe located near our colony has sent us a special purchase order.
[Reasonfortask],They are preparing to launch a series of new construction projects in the near future. However, due to insufficient supply of corresponding building materials, they want to purchase the following materials from us:

Any [requestedCategory_label] x [requestedThingCount] (total value: [requestedThingMarketValue_money])
If we accept this transaction order, we will need to send a long-distance team carrying the corresponding materials to the target location.
Estimated travel time: [estimatedTravelTime_duration].

If we complete this order, the willingness of the Golden Iris Empire to provide assistance to us will increase.

Note: Stone bricks can be delivered in batches.
Reasonfortask->Out of consideration for expanding the sphere of influence of the Golden Iris Empire
Reasonfortask->In order to promote economic exchange and commercial transactions
Reasonfortask->In order to build a new residential area in the outer city
Reasonfortask->To build new refugee camps to maintain regional stability
Reasonfortask->In order to expand residential areas to accommodate more residents
Reasonfortask->In order to build new industrial areas and promote the speed of colonial development
Reasonfortask->To create a conflict buffer zone
Reasonfortask->In order to build new cultural centers and planetariums
Reasonfortask->Out of consideration for rescuing more refugees and practicing humanitarianism
